brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a browser-based art piece riffing on the concept of a cloud chamber. Monitor the firehose, check for posts satisfying certain criteria (builder's choice, should generate 8 categories of "particle") that each leave their unique vapor trail on random path. Hit frequency = 1-10/s
note: built cloudchamber.bisks.net: a live cloud chamber for the firehose — every post is sorted into 8 particle species (muon/electron/positron/proton/alpha/gamma/neutrino/kaon) and streaks its own fading vapor trail through the tank.
